capabilities: Sync saved items and covers from five platforms
Search, filter and bulk-copy collected items
Group items into topics and series with wikilinks
Index local Markdown and PDF files and link them by source URL
Suggest tags, topics and summaries with optional AI
extras: Desktop only; installing the three plugin files is not enough, a matching local engine must be built and deployed and the data-directory and engine-script fields edited in data.json. AI is off by default and manual prompt mode needs no API key. Cookies are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, but the separate yt-dlp cookie file is plaintext.
motivation: The author notes that a tutorial on Bilibili, a reference on Xiaohongshu and a guide on Xiaoheihe may all belong to the same project, so they should be collected in one place instead of searched platform by platform.
problem: Saved references are scattered across several content platforms, so finding and reusing an item means searching each site separately.

relations.evidence: Breadcrumbs can support your own topic hierarchy

requires.name: Bilibili / YouTube / Xiaohongshu / MakerWorld / Xiaoheihe account

summary: Collector that syncs saved items from Bilibili, YouTube, Xiaohongshu, MakerWorld and Xiaoheihe into a searchable Obsidian library.
